+1d6 damage and +1 Autofire rating (Shotgun Shells too). Never concealable or silenced, and no Tech Upgrade fixes that. Price Category one above the base weapon (Very Expensive minimum). Existing BODY requirements rise by half the damage dice it now rolls (round up). With none, it gains a BODY minimum to wield (a mount also works): 2 × its damage dice, +2 if one-handed or a bow, +1 at ROF2, +2 if it only Autofires or had Autofire 5+. A Heavy Pistol at 4d6 needs BODY 11 (9 if you make it two-handed).

Cost: x1 Base Weapon Cost [Minimum 1,000eb]
Fits: All Non-Explosive Weapons which deal damage
